does: Loads several files into one FileFormatIO object in turn: for each path an LSF or LSX visitor is made and the object's own visit runs on it, so whether entries merge or replace is the subclass's visit; the game's own multi-file load (eoc::SpeakerManager::Load calls it with every module's file).

evidence.says: Windows pseudo-code: a loop over a Span of Path, EndsWith('.lsf') picks LSFObjectVisitor else DefaultObjectVisitor, then the visitor's load
the export's decorated name in CoreLib.dll
CoreLib.dll exports this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function
